name: A season's participants
description: The season's live participants, for its season admins and platform admins alone (P5) -- the one place a season admin reads a handle they did not type. Each row is a provider's login, whether it has resolved to an account yet (a listed member who has not signed in is `waiting`), and the resolved account's platform handle. The season-admin-only fragment resolves {game}/{slug}, 401s a dead session, 404s an unknown season and 403s anyone who is neither a platform admin nor a live member, and hands the season id down in temp_data.who.0.body.season_id.
